title: Verify: Null store focus clears scene focus unit tests
summary: Unit test that null store focus blurs focused objects
description: Write Phaser-mocked unit tests proving REQ-2.
acceptance_criteria: Setting focusedObjectId null blurs a focused object
No focus or blur call when nothing is focused and id is null

steps.symbol: new: it('blurs focused objects when focusedObjectId is null')
steps.action: Create a fake bookshelf with isFocused:true, call create(), set the store focus to 'bookshelf' then to null via setFocusedObject(null). Assert bookshelf.blur toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1).
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneFocus.test.ts -t 'blurs focused objects'
steps.expected: Test passes: blur called once after null

steps.symbol: new: it('does nothing when no object is focused and focus is null')
steps.action: Create a fake with isFocused:false, call create(), call setFocusedObject(null) on a store whose focusedObjectId is already null plus a call via setState. Assert focus and blur are not called.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneFocus.test.ts -t 'does nothing when no object'
steps.expected: Test passes: neither focus nor blur called
